name: shaderacademy-notebook
description: A TiddlyWiki study notebook built from Shader Academy guides and source code.

scripts.notebook:build: npm run notebook:import && tiddlywiki notebook --output dist --deletetiddlers "[[$:/plugins/tiddlywiki/tiddlyweb]] [[$:/plugins/tiddlywiki/filesystem]]" --build index
scripts.notebook:serve: npm run notebook:import && tiddlywiki notebook --listen host=127.0.0.1 port=8080
